byConcept.face-surprise: Use highly saturated primary colours with dramatic high contrast between bright highlights and deep shadows to amplify the shock expression.
byConcept.jp-telop: Apply vibrant neon and pastel colour palettes with punchy saturation and strong contrast between foreground and background elements.
byConcept.action: Push saturation and contrast dramatically; use bold primary colours with bright highlights against deep blacks to create visual pop and energy.
byConcept.object-spotlight: Use highly saturated colours with intense contrast between the product and a simplified background to make the subject pop.
byConcept.risk-warning: Apply deep blacks, bright highlights, and saturated warm accent colours to create dramatic visual tension and immediate eye-catch.
byConcept.soft-lifestyle: Use soft, warm pastels with moderate saturation and gentle glowing effects rather than harsh contrast to maintain approachable, whimsical mood.
byConcept.anime-style: Oversaturate colours with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, punchy neons and pastels, and artificial post-processing for intense visual pop.
byConcept.game-live: Use highly saturated vibrant primaries with high contrast lighting, exaggerated bright highlights against dark shadows, and densely packed visual elements.
